scope: Unlimited unhinted ordinary single-base deterministic row-dependent ORDER keys, including bound aliases/positions, row-sort/projection errors, late row events and prepared rebinding. Complete independent scalar, populated full-text, LIMIT0, FALSE and pinned PRIMARY controls retain their earlier phases. Entire compound-scalar ORDER, compound-alias resolution, bounded/filter/hinted/opaque header, volatile-key metadata, INTEGER-vs-DOUBLE parameter diagnostic and JSON-null diagnostic-name families remain open in the full756 audit. Every retained observation asserts its complete native outcome. Explicit PREPARE always sends a fresh command; retained EXECUTE rebinds without a closing PREPARE between calls. All 198 folded-row controls are retained: constant conditional branches, IFNULL/COALESCE, zero/NULL multiplication, UUID conversion, regex and overflow siblings preserve native phases even when a written row input cannot affect the value.
